# RepoCode

> RepoCode builds the smallest useful codebase context for a task, for AI coding agents and LLMs — give it a task, query, diff, or pull request plus a token budget, and it finds the relevant code, follows what it depends on, and fits the most useful version of it into that budget.

Discovers files, ranks them by structural importance, import centrality, recency, and relevance to a query, then fits the highest-ranked ones into a token budget — compressing lower-ranked files first rather than truncating. Scopes to `--query`, `--diff`, `--branch`, or `--pr` instead of packing a whole repository. Import tracing covers 11 languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, C, C++, PHP, and C#. Ships as a CLI, an MCP server, a GitHub Action that fails a PR check when its diff plus import context won't fit a budget, and an embeddable core library. No telemetry; nothing leaves the machine unless a network-touching flag (`--llm-provider`, `--query-mode semantic`, `--remote`) is explicitly set.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/README.md): quickstart, CLI reference, configuration, FAQ
- [MCP server](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/packages/mcp/README.md): tool reference and per-client setup for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/packages/github-action/README.md): setup, inputs and outputs, CI preconditions
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [Architecture](https://github.com/nextbridgehq/repocode/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): pipeline design

## Packages

- [repocode](https://www.npmjs.com/package/repocode): CLI — the primary user-facing entry point
- [@repocode/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@repocode/core): core pipeline library — embed it in your own tools
- [@repocode/mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@repocode/mcp): MCP server — exposes context tools to AI assistants
